title: Exact descent of tensoring with a fixed K-flat complex
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ its abelian module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use its unbounded derived category $D(R)$ and localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and the K-flat derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. For every K-flat complex $A$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] with flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the functors $B\mapsto A\otimes_R B$ and $B\mapsto B\otimes_R A$ preserve all quasi-isomorphisms and descend to exact functors $D(R)\to D(R)$, canonically identified with $QA\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}-$ and $-\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}QA$. Their coherent integer-shift comparisons are the localization of the signed total-complex maps in [lem-weil-pbc-total-tensor-integer-shifts]. They take cone triangles to distinguished triangles including the connecting map. Shifts preserve K-flatness and flat terms. On the full derived tensor bifunctor, chain maps between flat-term K-flat fixed arguments, and all derived maps obtained by their localization, induce transformations commuting with shifts in the varying argument; both orders of extracting shifts retain the signed compatibility of that leaf. No boundedness or flatness of cohomology is assumed.
